description.value: Uno Beef Noodle is a Taiwanese restaurant in Richmond specializing in authentic beef noodle soup prepared with traditional techniques. The focused menu spans noodle soups, dry noodles, bento rice combos, and appetizers, and the restaurant operates across two Richmond locations. It offers a warming, filling meal option for cyclists passing through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Uno Beef Noodle is an active Taiwanese restaurant with two Richmond locations and lists hours, menus, and a contact form, establishing it is open. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or explicit takeout service is mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM node lacks an address and phone; the website lists two addresses (No 2 Rd and Number 3 Rd) but does not clarify which corresponds to the OSM node's coordinates.
concerns: OSM node has no address; website lists two locations (8180 No 2 Rd #128, Blundell – Richmond, BC and 2811 Number 3 Rd #135, Richmond, BC) — unclear which corresponds to this OSM node's coordinates.
No phone number present in either OSM tags or the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Taiwanese restaurant with an active website and confirmed Richmond locations; a valid meal stop for touring cyclists.
